lines.zh: 我压低身子，绕着对手走。
lines.en: I keep low and circle my opponent.

lines.zh: 脚下踩出细响，我不在乎。
lines.en: My feet make small noises. I don't care.

lines.zh: 这一步迈得大，是为了拉近距离。
lines.en: A long stride — closing the gap.

lines.zh: 我把护腕勒紧，走了两步。
lines.en: I tighten my wristbands and take two steps.

lines.zh: 背对着墙，我不喜欢这样。
lines.en: My back to a wall. I don't like it.
I'm looking for an angle. Don't rush me.

lines.zh: 走位这东西，我练了十几年。
lines.en: Footwork like this, I've drilled for years.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面走，随时能扑出去。
lines.en: I move low along the ground, ready to spring.

lines.zh: 风从侧面来，我就顺风走。
lines.en: The wind comes from the side; I move with it.

lines.zh: 绕一圈，看看有没有别人。
lines.en: One circuit, checking for anyone else.
Heel down, ball of the foot pushing off.

lines.zh: 我退开半步，重新找准位置。
lines.en: Half a step back, re-finding my spot.

lines.zh: 我抱着手臂，看你怎么动。
lines.en: Arms crossed, I watch how you move.

lines.zh: 这些年，我打得比从前稳。
lines.en: These years have made me steadier.

lines.zh: 我把拳头松开，松松手指。
lines.en: I open my fist and flex my fingers.

lines.zh: 我还是会紧张，这改不了。
lines.en: I still get nervous. That won't change.
Standing here, the wind feels good.
I rub my chin and think it over.

lines.zh: 那只猫教的招式，我还记着。
lines.en: The moves that cat taught me, I still remember.
Fight or don't. Stop stalling.

lines.zh: 我活动了下肩膀，骨头响。
lines.en: I roll my shoulder and the joint pops.
This time I don't want to lose again.
I loosen the straps on my wrist guards.
Once the stance is set, don't fidget.

lines.zh: 我在想下一步该往哪走。
lines.en: I'm thinking about where to step next.
The scars on my arms are old debts.

lines.zh: 你站的位置，正好是我想要的。
lines.en: You're standing exactly where I want you.

lines.zh: 我认得那种眼神，你想打。
lines.en: I know that look. You want a fight.

lines.zh: 先别动，让我看看你的架势。
lines.en: Hold still. Let me see your stance.
Your hands are too low.
I don't like being underestimated.
This close, and you still stand there.

lines.zh: 我笑一下，不代表我放松。
lines.en: A smile doesn't mean I've relaxed.

lines.zh: 你的重心偏右脚，很明显。
lines.en: Your weight's on the right foot. Obvious.

lines.zh: 我抬手，只是把护腕弄好。
lines.en: My hand moves only to fix a wristband.

lines.zh: 我不算什么顶尖高手，可也不弱。
lines.en: I'm no top master, but I'm no weakling.

lines.zh: 你退了，说明你心里有数。
lines.en: You backed off. So you understand.
I know this street.

lines.zh: 你要说点什么吗？我听着。
lines.en: Anything to say? I'm listening.

lines.zh: 我往前压半步，你紧张了。
lines.en: I press half a step in and you tense.
A sharp tongue won't help. Hands matter.
Don't put your hands behind your back.

lines.zh: 我盯住的是你的脚，不是你的人。
lines.en: I'm watching your feet, not your face.
That move just showed me your level.
That one landed clean.
A half step back and my footing holds.
All right, you're stronger than I thought.

lines.zh: 我抹了下嘴角，还有血味。
lines.en: I wipe my mouth. Still tastes of blood.
Not yet. I can still stand.
The wristband took most of it. Lucky.
Two breaths, then hands back up.
Embarrassing, but not a loss.
That reminded me not to be careless.
It hurts, but the stance stays.
That smell has split my focus.
I am hungry. Don't laugh.
Put it on the ground. I'll get it myself.
Smells fresh. Just made?
I reach for it with one eye still on you.

lines.zh: 吃完这顿，我能多打一会儿。
lines.en: With a meal in me I can last longer.
Your treat? Then I won't be polite.
I'll take half and leave half.
This taste reminds me of before.
Don't use food to split my attention.

lines.zh: 撞这么一下，你也退了吧。
lines.en: One bump, and you stepped back too.
I'm steady. No need to catch me.

lines.zh: 肩膀碰肩膀，算打过招呼。
lines.en: Shoulder to shoulder — consider us introduced.
Don't crowd me. Nowhere to step back.
I turned aside, and you didn't stop.
That was a solid hit.

lines.zh: 我们离得太近，招式都没法用。
lines.en: We're too close for technique.
Sorry, I didn't watch my feet.

lines.zh: 你撞上来的时候，我绷紧了。
lines.en: I braced when you came in.
Steady yourself before we talk.
I'm clumsy about things like this.
Don't laugh. I'm serious.
I always trained alone before.
Having someone watch isn't so bad.
My hands are calloused. Don't mind.
The wind's strong. Come closer.

lines.zh: 别担心，我不会再输给自己。
lines.en: Don't worry. I won't lose to myself again.
I'd like to stand here a while longer.

lines.zh: 我记住了你今天的样子。
lines.en: I'll remember how you look today.
Let's go. It's getting dark.
I bend and pick it up cleanly.
This is yours. Don't lose it.
I toss it and weigh it in my hand.
I'll return it after the fight.
This thing on the ground looks familiar.
I tuck it in my belt and free my hands.
I bend and sweep it into my pocket.
Could this work as a weapon?
I hand it to whoever's beside me.
Even picking something up, watch your back.
You moved. So it's started.
I've locked onto your feet.

lines.zh: 这么近的距离，我占便宜。
lines.en: At this range, I've got the advantage.
Ki gathers in my palm and starts spinning.

lines.zh: 你这一手，我见过类似的。
lines.en: I've seen something like that before.
I drop low, ready to charge.
No more holding back on either side.
The ground favors me.
You hesitated. So I go first.
Ki in my hand, steady.
I don't like opening with a killing move.

lines.zh: 这一片空地，够我们打了。
lines.en: This clearing is room enough.
Three seconds of watching. Enough.
There's a seam in your guard.
Wolf Fang Fist — starting at three.
I plant my feet in the dirt.
I turn with you, feet never leaving the ground.

lines.zh: 你往哪走，我的气就往哪。
lines.en: Where you go, my ki follows.
My weight sits on my left foot.
Your breathing's gone shallow. Don't force it.
That stance — you're setting up a kick.
I back off a foot and open the distance.

lines.zh: 你绕了三圈，还是这个位置。
lines.en: Three circles and you're back in the same spot.
No rush. I've trained patience.
The ki in my hand is getting hot.

lines.zh: 你的影子在我脚下，别动。
lines.en: Your shadow's at my feet. Hold still.
I'm counting how many blows you can take.

lines.zh: 你的护肩有一道旧裂痕。
lines.en: There is an old crack in your shoulder guard.
I've been setting this up a while.

lines.zh: 你一抬手，我就知道要打哪。
lines.en: When you raise a hand, I know where it's going.
Don't think I only know how to brawl.

lines.zh: 我笑，是因为我看见破绽了。
lines.en: I'm smiling because I found your gap.

lines.zh: 距离刚好，再近一步就动手。
lines.en: Perfect distance. One step more and I move.
Standing like that will wear you out.

lines.zh: 狼牙风风拳，这一套你接得住吗？
lines.en: Wolf Fang Fist — can you take the whole set?
A blur of fists. Too many to count.

lines.zh: 我先打你的护臂，再打脸。
lines.en: I hit your guard, then your face.
My heel lands first, then the fist.
I step in close and use the elbow.
Three strikes, one step back.

lines.zh: 你挡得住一下，挡不住这一串。
lines.en: You block one. Not the string.
This style I worked out myself.
I'm hitting your flank. Don't turn.
My fist comes with the wind behind it.

lines.zh: 气裹着手腕，打出去更重。
lines.en: Ki wraps my wrist; the blow lands heavier.
I start from low.
I pull my fist back and step three paces off.
You retreat fast; I keep pace.

lines.zh: 这一套打完，我自己也喘。
lines.en: After that set, I'm winded too.
Don't underestimate an Earthling.

lines.zh: 我拉开架势，站到这片地上。
lines.en: I set my stance and take this ground.

lines.zh: 这回，我不会一上来就倒。
lines.en: This time I won't go down early.

lines.zh: 狼牙风风拳，手上全是气。
lines.en: Wolf Fang Fist — my fists full of ki.
Good wind for a fight.
I walk into the field step by step.

lines.zh: 手上的气，已经聚起来了。
lines.en: Ki is already gathered in my hands.
I'm here. Don't expect manners.
My feet are planted well on this ground.

lines.zh: 我扭头看看身后，确认没人。
lines.en: I glance behind to make sure no one's there.

lines.zh: 十几年练的东西，今天用上。
lines.en: Years of training, used today.
I grit my teeth and step forward.
Wristbands on, the weight feels right.
I'll stand and read my opponent first.
The soil is loose. Careful.
I sink my weight. Steady.
I want to win this one.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，示意可以开始。
lines.en: I raise a hand — we can begin.

lines.zh: 我来了，虽然手心里全是汗。
lines.en: I'm here, though my palms are sweating.
Fire caught my arm and the skin puckered.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下来，差点站不起来。
lines.en: I fell from height and barely got up.

lines.zh: 嘴里全是水，气都提不上来。
lines.en: My mouth fills with water; I can't raise ki.

lines.zh: 爆风把我推出去好几步。
lines.en: The blast pushed me back several steps.
Something's stuck in my leg.

lines.zh: 这力气很邪，压得我抬不起手。
lines.en: This force is foul; I can't lift my arms.
I should have eaten.

lines.zh: 雷通过身体，手脚一起麻。
lines.en: Lightning ran through me; hands and feet numb.

lines.zh: 底下什么都没有，站不住。
lines.en: Nothing underfoot. Can't stand.
